orchestra.desc: The workspace orchestrator coordinates agents and schedules recurring work across all projects.

blueprint.desc: Your workspace knowledge base. Agents read the Blueprint to understand context, rules, and goals.

assistant.desc: The assistant helps you draft, plan, and run work across the workspace in plain language.
